description: An animated visualiser of coloured blocks that flock by the Craig Reynolds boids algorithm, with a waveform drawn over them

params.text: Steps the background through colour, black and white, and black
Steps the waveform drawing through lines, blocks and off

inputs.text: Higher voltage separates the colours of neighbouring blocks further
Higher voltage brings the rates at which neighbouring blocks change colour closer together
Higher voltage converges the blocks on a single colour
Sets the colour the blocks drift towards, as a pitch voltage, each note of the scale standing for a colour
A trigger steps the waveform drawing through lines, blocks and off
A trigger steps the background through colour, black and white, and black
A trigger draws the pixelated pattern picked on the menu

notes: placing another Photron beside this one blends the colours across both
holding D and clicking in the display draws with the mouse
menu: Processing rate — how often the animation is redrawn: 60 Hz, 45 Hz, 30 Hz, 20 Hz, 15 Hz, 12 Hz or 10 Hz, a lower rate asking less of the processor and slowing the animation
Lissajous mode — draws the two inputs against each other as a Lissajous figure rather than as a waveform
Pattern — picks which 8-bit character is drawn
Lock Pattern — holds the drawn pattern instead of letting it blend away
